notes.title: Change Log 4/15
notes.content:
Small patch of visual improvements and fixes

[h1]---PATCH NOTES---[/h1]

[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved shadow quality
[*] Reduced number of shadow casters on several maps, improving performance
[*] Fixed UVs in several locations for better texture mapping
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved issue where Goat overlay would stay above the pause menu
[*] Resolved issue where Goat animations would stop playing
[*] Made improvements to potential positions the Crown Teleporter could bring you
[*] Added failsafes and improvements to prevent players getting stuck in ragdoll state
[*] Jesse O'Brien — 04/12/2024 10:11 PM
[/list]

notes.title: Change Log 11/10/23
notes.content:
Our first round of fixes for the Beta build, this patch addresses a number of general bugs, quality of life improvements, and collider issues.


[h3]---[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]---[/h3]

-Fixed a bug where players could still grab the crown while stunned.

-Fixed a bug where players could fall through terrain as a result of the game being paused.

-Updated the controls graphic in the menu.

-Removed ice from the lowest section of Viking Village to prevent frustration with that area.

-Resolved several issues with colliders in the game.

      -Improved Backyard BBQ bridge collider.
      
      -Improved Backyard BBQ stair colliders.
      
      -Modified props across several levels to prevent players from getting stuck on top of them.
      
      -Blocked off an area of Viking Village where players were getting caught.

      -Eliminated a hole in the Crusty Canyon level.
      
      -Blocked off rooftops on Viking Village.
